# volcano_project_source_export (Resource)

Triggers a one-shot export of a project's source to a git repository (a git takeover). This is a one-shot operation modeled as create+read+delete: Delete cancels/clears the export record via the API's own DELETE, it does not undo an already-completed handover.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_project_source_export" "example" {
  project_id        = volcano_project.example.id
  production_branch = "main"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `production_branch` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `branch` (String)
- `commit_sha` (String)
- `exported_at` (String)
- `file_count` (Number)
- `handed_over_at` (String)
- `mode` (String)
- `omitted` (List of String)
- `repo_full_name` (String)
- `skipped` (List of String)
- `transition_started_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_project_source_export.example <project-id>
```
